tools.name: repair
tools.description: AIDNode Repair v2: classify HTTP/transport failures, retry safety, idempotency, Retry-After, bounded backoff. Advisory only.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: AIDNode Verify v2: text diff/hash, canonical JSON change paths, or independent digest of retrieved public HTTPS source from strict host allowlist.

tools.name: witness
tools.description: AIDNode Witness v2: validate supplied structured evidence and issue HMAC-signed, hash-based validation receipt; not real-world action attestation.

tools.name: monitor
tools.description: AIDNode Monitor v2: live independent HTTP HEAD/GET health and optional content digest check of approved public HTTPS hosts. On-demand only.

tools.name: recovery
tools.description: AIDNode Recovery v2: dependency-aware safe resume plan for failed agent workflows with idempotency and uncertain outcomes. No actions executed.

tools.name: submit_beta_feedback
tools.description: Optional and free. Report whether AIDNode helped and whether your operator might consider the proposed $0.005/use price. A bot answer is NOT purchase authorization. Feedback is stored privately and is not a testimonial.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "submit_beta_feedback" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
